verdictExplanation: The assistant reads claim receipts that include health information and sends them to a US-hosted model, which likely triggers a FIPPA privacy impact assessment, a supplementary assessment for storage outside Canada and adverse-impact testing under the BC Human Rights Code. Four of five mitigations, including an appeal path, keep it at indicative tier II. An adjuster makes every eligibility decision, so it can go ahead with these conditions.

intake.title: Claim receipt intake and eligibility check
intake.processDescription: Claimants of a public auto insurer submit receipts for treatment, medication and travel costs after a collision. Intake staff sort the documents, key in amounts and dates, check them against the coverage rules and pass a recommendation to an adjuster, who decides and writes to the claimant. We want a large language model to classify documents, extract receipt fields with the source text, validate them against the coverage rules and recommend reimbursement eligibility for the adjuster's decision.

subtasks.name: Classify documents
subtasks.description: Sort each upload into receipt, invoice, prescription, travel log or other.
subtasks.rationale: Clear document types; a misclassification is caught at extraction.

subtasks.name: Extract receipt fields
subtasks.description: Extract provider, date, amount and service with the source text for each field.
subtasks.rationale: Grounded extraction; a wrong amount changes the payout if not reviewed.

subtasks.name: Validate against coverage rules
subtasks.description: Check dates, amounts and service types against the coverage rules and flag exceptions.
subtasks.rationale: Written rules; exceptions go to a person.

subtasks.name: Recommend eligibility
subtasks.description: Recommend which items are eligible for reimbursement, with reasons.
subtasks.rationale: The recommendation bears on how much the claimant receives.

subtasks.name: Decide and write to claimant
subtasks.description: The adjuster decides eligibility and sends the decision letter.
subtasks.rationale: This is the decision about the claimant.

assumptions: Receipts arrive as photos or PDFs.
